_comment: Exactly what this extension needs from Audiobookshelf. If upstream changes any of it, the extension breaks in a way that looks like an empty book list or covers with no strips rather than an error - so it is listed here, the API shapes are asserted against the recorded fixtures beside this file by TestContract in tests/python/test_absh.py, the whole of it is exercised against a real server by tests/real at both ends of the supported range, and tools/check_upstream.py quotes it into the issue it opens.

endpoints.used_for: Settings naming the server's version, and saying when it is older than the oldest supported
checking that the URL and API key work
the folder an upload goes into

fields: results[].updatedAt, which moves when the book's details or files change

endpoints.used_for: one click copying everything a series page lists
fields: the filter value is encodeURIComponent(base64(series id)), as the app's $encode makes it

endpoints.used_for: one click copying everything an author page lists
one click copying everything a collection page lists
one click copying the books a playlist page lists
fields: items[].episodeId, set only for podcast episodes, which are left out

endpoints.used_for: copying file by file, only what changed, and the tags Embed Metadata would write
fields: media.metadata.title, subtitle, authors[].name, narrators[], series[].name and sequence
the tags mirror getFFMetadataObject in server/utils/ffmpegHelpers.js

endpoints.used_for: fetching one file of a book, when only it changed
fields: accepts the API key as an Authorization: Bearer header

endpoints.used_for: fetching a book to copy to the player
fields: accepts the API key as an Authorization: Bearer header
returns a single audio file, or a zip for a multi-file book
Content-Type contains "zip" for the multi-file case
endpoints.note: Audiobookshelf also takes the key as ?token=, but a key in a URL ends up in logs and proxies, so it is never sent that way (store/PRIVACY.md).

endpoints.used_for: having Audiobookshelf embed a book's details into its files before a copy (its Embed Metadata tool); admin only, 403 otherwise, 400 when that book is already queued
fields: starts a task and answers 200 at once
rewrites the files in place with ffmpeg, keeping each inode; size and mtime in the database stay stale until a rescan

endpoints.used_for: when a file of a book is a 404 to download, having Audiobookshelf read the book's folder again so its list of files matches the disk, then fetching it once more; admin only, 403 otherwise
fields: answers when the scan is done, with result

endpoints.used_for: waiting for that embed to finish
uploading a book that is only on the player
fields: multipart: library, folder, title, author, series, file0..n

endpoints.used_for: the tests only, making a key the way a user does; added in v2.26.0, which is why that is the oldest supported
